title.value: Learning to repeatedly solve routing problems
title.justification: The title is directly extracted from the paper header and abstracts the core contribution of the research which focuses on a new method for solving routing problems efficiently.
title.quote: Learning to repeatedly solve routing problems

extractions.description: The paper introduces a learned heuristic for reoptimizing the capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) when there are minor changes in client demands. The method predicts which parts of a previous solution remain optimal, allowing the reduction of problem complexity and faster solution time. Applications extend to scenarios where slight data modifications occur frequently.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily addresses routing problems and optimization techniques with no direct mention of climate or ecological impacts. It focuses on the computational efficiency of solving repeated routing problems using machine learning, without direct connections to sustainability themes.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In the last years, there has been a great interest in machine-learning-based heuristics for solving NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems. The developed methods have shown potential on many optimization problems.

primary_category.quote: The goal is to predict the parts of the solution that have a high probability of remaining the same.

applications.value: Heuristic for capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP)
applications.justification: The paper presents a heuristic designed specifically to improve computational efficiency in solving the CVRP by predicting stable parts of the solution when demands change slightly.
applications.quote: The goal of the CVRP is to construct vehicle routes in order to serve geographically-dispersed clients while minimizing the travel costs and respecting vehicle capacity.
